counterfactual_missing_items: No family history of similar complaints
decisive_items: Epsilon wave present in lead V4
Global hypokinesia of right ventricle, dilated RV, ballooned out RVOT measuring 35 mm
Postcontrast hyperenhancement along RV free wall, RVOT apical wall, RV aspect of septum, and in basal inferior, midcavity inferior, and inferoseptal myocardium of left ventricle
response.rationale: R2 uniquely integrates the epsilon wave, severe RV dilation/dysfunction, and postcontrast RV/LV enhancement, which are diagnostic of ARVC. R1 only captures the presenting wide complex tachycardia, a complication rather than the underlying cardiomyopathy. C1 is a redundant subset of R2 with no additional raw support.

rejected.why: Redundant append-only completion of R2; its raw spans are a subset of R2's and add no independent diagnostic information.
